cards.ex: I'll get in touch with you next week to discuss the project.
cards.exUz: Men siz bilan keyingi hafta loyihani muhokama qilish uchun bog'lanaman.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir aloqada bo'lish, xabar olishmoq.

cards.ex: Drop me a line when you get to London.
cards.exUz: Londonga yetib borgach, menga xabar yozib yubor.

cards.ex: Check out that new movie; it's supposed to be really good.
cards.exUz: O'sha yangi kinoni tekshirib ko'r; juda yaxshi deyishadi.

cards.ex: I missed the meeting; can you fill me in?
cards.exUz: Men yig'ilishni o'tkazib yubordim; menga ma'lumot bera olasizmi?

cards.ex: To be honest, I didn't really like the book.
cards.exUz: Rostini aytsam, kitob menga unchalik yoqmadi.

cards.ex: I need to sort out my finances this weekend.
cards.exUz: Men bu hafta oxiri moliyaviy masalalarimni hal qilib qo'yishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki tartibga solish.

cards.ex: I get along with my coworkers really well.
cards.exUz: Men hamkasblarim bilan juda yaxshi kelishaman.

cards.ex: Let's make a deal: I'll do the dishes, and you can clean the living room.
cards.exUz: Keling, kelishuv tuzamiz: men idishlarni yuvaman, siz esa mehmonxonani tozalaysiz.

cards.ex: The exam was a piece of cake!
cards.exUz: Imtihon juda oson edi!

cards.ex: By the way, did you hear about Sarah's promotion?
cards.exUz: Aytganday, Sarahning lavozimga ko'tarilganini eshitdingizmi?

cards.ex: I'm going to take it easy this weekend and just relax.
cards.exUz: Men bu hafta oxiri dam olaman va shunchaki hordiq chiqaraman.

cards.ex: Let's hang out at the park this afternoon.
cards.exUz: Keling, bugun tushdan keyin parkda vaqt o'tkazamiz.

cards.ex: Give me a shout when you're free.
cards.exUz: Qachon bo'sh bo'lsang, menga xabar ber.

cards.ex: It's not a big deal if you're late.
cards.exUz: Agar kechiksangiz, bu unchalik muhim emas.

cards.ex: Keep me posted on the progress of the project.
cards.exUz: Meni loyiha rivoji haqida xabardor qilib turing.

cards.ex: "I'm sorry I'm late." "No worries!"
cards.exUz: "Kech qolganim uchun uzr." "Xavotir olmang!"

cards.ex: It's up to you where we go for dinner.
cards.exUz: Qayerga kechki ovqatga borishimiz sizning ixtiyoringizda.

cards.ex: I need to get this report done by Friday.
cards.exUz: Men bu hisobotni juma kuniga qadar tugatishim kerak.

cards.ex: To cut a long story short, we won the game!
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, biz o'yinda g'alaba qozondik!
cards.term: to cut a long story short

cards.ex: At the end of the day, it's your decision.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, bu sizning qaroringiz.
cards.term: at the end of the day

cards.ex: He didn't show up. It figures.
cards.exUz: U kelmadi. Tushunarli.

cards.ex: Just chill out and enjoy the movie.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki dam oling va kinodan zavqlaning.

cards.ex: You need to make up your mind about what you want to study.
cards.exUz: Qanday o'qishni xohlashingiz haqida qaror qilishingiz kerak.

cards.ex: We need to make sure we're all on the same page before we start the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha boshlashdan oldin, barchamiz bir xil fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: I forgot your birthday, but it's no big deal, right?
cards.exUz: Men tug'ilgan kuningizni unutdim, lekin bu unchalik muhim emas, to'g'rimi?

cards.ex: I look forward to seeing you again soon.
cards.exUz: Sizni tez orada yana ko'rishni intizorlik bilan kutaman.

cards.ex: Thanks for the heads up about the traffic jam.
cards.exUz: Yo'l tirbandligi haqida ogohlantirganingiz uchun rahmat.

cards.ex: Are you done with the report? Pretty much.
cards.exUz: Hisobotni tugatdingizmi? Deyarli.

cards.ex: I'm just saying, maybe you should consider another option.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki aytdim, balki boshqa variantni ko'rib chiqishingiz kerak.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss progress.
cards.exUz: Keling, keyingi hafta rivojlanishni muhokama qilish uchun aloqaga chiqamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa uchrashuv yoki telefon orqali aloqaga chiqish.
